name: After Effects TikTok Edit
description: SuperTool: tiktok, shake, ray-zoom, vignette, flicker, psychedelic

intensity.label: intensity
intensity.description: Overall blend with source video (0 = passthrough)

shakeAmount.label: shakeAmount
shakeAmount.description: Multiplier on the chaotic UV warp

audioShakeBoost.label: audioShakeBoost
audioShakeBoost.description: Extra shake at peak audio (bass/RMS). DISCO default = 0 (no audio reactivity)

rayDecay.label: rayDecay
rayDecay.description: UV scale step per ray-zoom iteration

audioRayBoost.label: audioRayBoost
audioRayBoost.description: Extra ray count fraction at peak audio. DISCO default = 0 (no audio reactivity)

saturation.label: saturation
saturation.description: Desat-matrix parameter (DISCO original = 0.3). Note: at 0.3 the matrix mostly darkens the image ~3.4×; it is not a true saturation control
